name: Elmo Rise
look: Elmo, the red furry Sesame Street puppet with big white eyes and an orange nose, raises both arms triumphantly with his mouth open while a wall of orange flames burns behind him against a black background.
use: Stands for gleeful chaos or embracing evil: someone happily causing trouble or reveling as everything goes wrong. The caption names the chaotic act.
examples: Me leaving one second on the microwave timer
When you reply-all to the company email just to say thanks
